title: The book
summary: What the book covers and how it grows.
description: The content itself: a tree of pages made of blocks. The book is never done; pages are added and revised as interests and understanding change.

requirements.text: The book covers the topics in `book.topics`.
Any part of the book can be revised at any time; there is no finished or published state that locks it.
The book's content is a set of notes, and a note can link to any other note.

deprecation.reason: The book is organised as a tree of pages instead of a flat set of notes.

requirements.text: A chapter is an ordered arrangement of notes chosen by the author.

deprecation.reason: The book is organised as a tree of pages instead of a flat set of notes. The tree's order is the reading order, so chapters need no separate arrangement.

values.description: The fields the book is about.
